rows.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
rows.location: London (secondary: San Francisco, Boston, New York)
rows.why: Lovable's whole product is people shipping software without writing it, which is exactly the seam Prabhavit works in — he led a live Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel migration and shipped production AI agents, so he has both sides of the no-code-to-real-code story their customers hit. Founding-member FDE scope (translating customer ideas into working products) maps onto his FlowSpace ownership of business logic, integrations and delivery.
rows.watch_outs: London-primary; his EU long-term residence permit does not cover UK on-site work, so ask up front whether they engage a contractor from Italy. Ashby workplaceType is null (not flagged remote). Founding-member framing at a hypergrowth company means a high bar.

rows.title: Contract Solutions Engineer
rows.location: Remote — board index shows both "Remote EU" and "New UK Remote" wording
rows.comp: Not disclosed (day rate not stated on the index)
